From the feedback/ updates received from Insurers, it is observed that many of the insurers still have not finalised their Gap Analysis report, Cyber Crisis Ensuring that Information and Computer Technology **(ICT)** infrastructure of insurers are fully secured is of paramount importance. Any Vulnerabilities to !CT may result in compromise on confidentiality of policyholder related information and exposure to sensitive information of the insurance sector and the financial markets in general. - of the country as a whole. - Audit for their ICT infrastructures including Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration - audit findings are rectified swiftly. Insurers are al!so requested to firm-up their Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) for handling cyber incidents more effectively. The recently registered insurers and Reinsurers also must ensure that steps are taken for of the Guidelines. In case CISOs have not yet been appointed by the Confirmation of having noted the above and plan of action proposed may be
